# Selected official GFM extension examples

Extracted without changing Markdown or expected HTML from
https://github.github.com/gfm/ (GFM 0.29-gfm), on 2026-11-16.
Examples 198–205 cover tables, 279–280 task list items, and 491–493 strikethrough.
Whitespace display spans were decoded back to their original characters.

SHA-256 of extensions.json: `bd226b5b6cbaa5d848f31528993e0a3269f478acce9a49cf698893211acf6e87`

These examples derive from the CommonMark/GFM specification and retain
CC-BY-SA-4.0. The upstream CommonMark licence notice is included. This selected
suite does not claim support for GFM's separate bare-autolink/tag-filter features.
